items.title: Bare Maple Tree
items.alt: A complete young bare maple tree has a textured gray brown trunk, distinct branching limbs and small buds above a tidy snowy earth base.
items.description: A complete young bare maple tree has a textured gray brown trunk, distinct branching limbs and small buds above a tidy snowy earth base. An original maple illustration for personal projects and classroom nature activities.
